cohort: 300 women who had recently given birth in India
finding: The prevalence of PPD was 18.7%, and higher educational attainment, higher socioeconomic class, previous depression, pregnancy/labor complications, maternal age over 35, and cesarean section delivery were significantly associated with increased PPD risk.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in PPD rates between vaginal and cesarean deliveries among mothers with deceased newborns.
